checks.description: 额度快照及套餐到期表的完整列定义、自增序列、默认值、主键和可用索引满足读写契约
checks.sql: WITH expected(suffix, column_name, data_type, required, default_kind) AS (VALUES ('_provider_quota_snapshots','id','int8',true,'sequence'), ('_provider_quota_snapshots','account_key','text',true,''), ('_provider_quota_snapshots','source_kind','text',true,''), ('_provider_quota_snapshots','collected_at','timestamptz',true,''), ('_provider_quota_snapshots','ok','bool',true,''), ('_provider_quota_snapshots','snapshot','jsonb',true,''), ('_provider_plan_expiry_edits','id','int8',true,'sequence'), ('_provider_plan_expiry_edits','identity_key','text',true,''), ('_provider_plan_expiry_edits','end_time','timestamptz',false,''), ('_provider_plan_expiry_edits','updated_by','text',true,''), ('_provider_plan_expiry_edits','updated_at','timestamptz',true,'now')), columns_ok AS (SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expected e LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=to_regclass($1 || e.suffix) LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attname=e.column_name AND NOT a.attisdropped LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=c.oid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE c.relkind IS DISTINCT FROM 'r' OR a.atttypid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regtype(e.data_type) OR a.attnotnull IS DISTINCT FROM e.required OR (e.default_kind='now' AND COALESCE(pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),'') NOT IN ('now()','CURRENT_TIMESTAMP')) OR (e.default_kind='sequence' AND (COALESCE(pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),'') NOT LIKE 'nextval(%' OR pg_get_serial_sequence(format('%I.%I',n.nspname,c.relname),'id') IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint p WHERE p.conrelid=c.oid AND p.contype='p' AND p.convalidated AND p.conkey=ARRAY[a.attnum])))) AS ok), expected_indexes(suffix, index_suffix, first_column, second_column) AS (VALUES ('_provider_quota_snapshots','_account_time_idx','account_key','collected_at'),('_provider_plan_expiry_edits','_identity_idx','identity_key','id')), indexes_ok AS (SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM expected_indexes e LEFT JOIN pg_index i ON i.indexrelid=to_regclass($1 || e.suffix || e.index_suffix) LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=to_regclass($1 || e.suffix) AND a.attname=e.first_column AND NOT a.attisdropped LEFT JOIN pg_attribute b ON b.attrelid=to_regclass($1 || e.suffix) AND b.attname=e.second_column AND NOT b.attisdropped WHERE i.indrelid IS DISTINCT FROM to_regclass($1 || e.suffix) OR i.indisvalid IS DISTINCT FROM true OR i.indisready IS DISTINCT FROM true OR i.indnatts IS DISTINCT FROM 2 OR i.indnkeyatts IS DISTINCT FROM 2 OR i.indpred IS NOT NULL OR i.indexprs IS NOT NULL OR i.indkey::text IS DISTINCT FROM format('%s %s',a.attnum,b.attnum) OR i.indoption::text IS DISTINCT FROM '0 3') AS ok) SELECT columns_ok.ok AND indexes_ok.ok AS ok FROM columns_ok,indexes_ok
